claims.claim: It is a Lexus LX460 engine.
claims.evidence: Witness report lists brand and model as null; no badge, plate, or VIN is described in Photo 0.

claims.claim: It is from Japan or a Japanese import.
claims.evidence: No origin marking, import stamp, or documentation appears in the witness report.
Photo 0 shows a removed engine with intake manifold, valve cover, alternator, serpentine belt, pulleys, hoses, wiring harness, and sensors.

risks.risk: The engine does not run or start.
risks.proof: Video of the engine cranking and running on a stand or in a vehicle.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a non-running core or block only.

risks.proof: Photo of the donor vehicle odometer or import/service documents showing year and mileage.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as high-mileage and unknown age.

risks.risk: It may not fit a Lexus LX460 because the donor vehicle is unidentified.
risks.proof: Photo of the engine number, VIN plate, or documentation matching a Lexus LX460.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as unknown fitment; the buyer assumes it may not fit the LX460.

risks.risk: Internal damage or wear with no compression test.
risks.proof: Compression test results or a borescope video of the cylinder bores and valves.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as internally worn or damaged.

risks.risk: The ECU, mounts, or full wiring harness are missing.
risks.proof: Photo showing all included accessories laid out with the engine.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as engine only, with no accessories included.

proof_requests: Video of the engine running and reaching operating temperature.
Photo of the engine block number and any visible identification plate.
Photo showing all included accessories such as ECU, mounts, alternator, and wiring harness.
Compression test results or borescope video of the cylinders.
response.reason: The witness confirms a used car engine, so it can be valued at its worst case as a non-running, untested unit of unknown fitment; proof of running condition, identity, and accessories would raise the value.
